mechanism: Indomethacin reduces renal potassium excretion by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated effects on the collecting duct, increasing hyperkalemia risk especially in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitor/ARB use.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid potassium supplementation unless necessary; consider alternative NSAIDs or discontinue indomethacin if hyperkalemia develops.
